dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm not sure. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Oh dear... This could be a problem...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you paint them red.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: You will! Thank you, thank you! You're such a kindhearted friend!

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: ...Ah! I'm so lucky to have met you, friend. Please help me paint these balloons a romantic red.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Romantic red balloons... I'm sure such beauty will stir the heart of my beloved!

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Isn't that right, friend?

choices.text: I'm... not the best person to ask.

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: Whatever happens, thank you so much, friend. Stay awhile, I'd like to introduce you to Yopoyi.

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: Given what time it is... Hmm, she should be here any moment now. We made an appointment and everything.

choices.text: I'm sure she'll be swept off her feet.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Yopoyi! You came!

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: Ziki? It's you... What's with the outfit?

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: I'm a Nanasian — your favorite! I rented the costume specially. How do I look? Oh, and these balloons — I prepared them just for you!

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Actually, there's something I've been wanting to say for a long time... Please go out with me!

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: ...Are you for real?

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: I am! My lovely lady, Yopoyi, please, say you'll go out on a date with me!

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: Did you hit your head getting into that costume or something? This is our third anniversary! We're MARRIED!

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: I know that! It's just... you're always telling me how unromantic I am... and I never properly confessed my love before our marriage... I know it's late, but this is my confession to you!

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: Haha... So that's it, huh? Alright then, of course I'll go out with you.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: For real?

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: Yes, for real, you silly romantic fool, you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A gust of wind blows by, and the lovers embrace.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Please don't pop these balloons! If you want some to play with, I have some others I can give you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: These balloons look special.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: It's a little embarrassing to say, but they're very important items to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: I'm sure you can guess their purpose just by looking at them, right?

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: Actually, they're for a romantic confession.

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: I plan to use these romantic balloons to confess my love to my beloved Yopoyi! Well? What do you think?

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: Hmm... You've got a point. Gosh, is my spirit of romance still not up to scratch?

response.speaker: Ziki
response.text: Yopoyi's going to be here any minute! Where am I even going to find some red balloons?

dialogues.speaker: Ziki
dialogues.text: Thank you, kind friend.

dialogues.speaker: Yopoyi
dialogues.text: Has Ziki been causing you trouble? His thought process can be a little unconventional, but that's what I like about him.
